profile.headline: Senior Front End Software Developer at Uber
profile.summary:
I’m a Front-End Software Engineer with over a decade of experience designing and building reliable, scalable web applications. At Uber, I work on the Earner Onboarding (Bonjour) platform, shaping how new earners join and grow on the platform through thoughtful front-end architecture and system reliability.

I’ve architected experiences like Modular Onboarding (MOB), Gigs-Based Post Onboarding, and Vehicle Inspection flows, and improved analytics and testing frameworks that make these products more stable and insightful.

Before Uber, I built front-end systems for Abercrombie & Fitch and JadeTrack, working across e-commerce, analytics, and data visualization. I care about developer experience, clean architecture, and mentoring engineers to build software that lasts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Own and deliver key front-end experiences within Uber’s Earner Onboarding (Bonjour) platform, powering onboarding and post-onboarding journeys for hundreds of thousands of earners globally.

- Architected front-end systems for Modular Onboarding (MOB) and the Gigs-Based Post Onboarding Platform, enabling scalable multi-gig onboarding and rapid feature launches.

- Owned Bonjour’s web analytics and event emission architecture, migrating to Unified Web Analytics (UWA) and improving reliability while reducing dropped events by 9%.

- Built the front-end component testing framework, eliminating flakiness across P0 flows (100% → 0%) and restoring full integration test coverage.

- Architected and owned Vehicle Inspection front-end flows, including virtual and map-based inspections adopted across onboarding and post-onboarding experiences.

- Mentor and support front-end engineers across the Earner Onboarding team, providing guidance on architecture, testing, and observability best practices.

- Partnered across 10+ services to deliver London Traffic Isolation, ensuring regulatory compliance and enabling Uber’s continued operation in the London market.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Web Development · Front-End Design · React.js

positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Developer
positions.description:
• Fullstack development with a front end focus.
• Improved the user experience and front end performance of the user role management functionality using AngularJS.
• Modified energy analytics charts to provide the user with more functionality and improved site navigation.
• Implemented selective feature toggling based on user groups using C# and JavaScript.
• Creating user flows for tracking new and linking existing energy meters for the City of Columbus.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Completed SharePoint 2013 Power User and Development training program.
- Developed public websites using Javascript frameworks such as React.js and Node.js as well as  traditional Javascript.
- Adapted to large codebase to restructure the HTML, Javascript, and ASP.NET backend.
- Built custom SharePoint client-facing public website based on visual composition.
- Worked in an agile team to complete changing requirements for large-scale and small-scale projects.
- Converted visual compositions into working live websites on-top of Kentico CMS and Node.js.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
- Staffing role as a G2O consultant with continuous contract renewal.
- Successfully developed front-end for the "forgot password" feature that helped convert users into 
  paying customers. Bringing in 4 million in increased measured revenue.
- Utilized Javascript, HTML, SASS, and JSP to complete projects including building completely new 
  experiences, redesigning existing experiences, and restructuring site features to improve performance 
   and user engagement.
- Tech designed and developed mobile email subscription feature, increasing total user subscription 
   and providing 2.3 million in measured revenue
- Collaborated with team members to create, organize, and estimate upcoming user stories and 
   developer tasks. Provided input to business owners on how the requested feature would impact the 
   codebase and the user experience.
- Developer in the Loyalty team, which received a EM CDP Recognition & Thanks Award celebrating $8 
  million in benefit and over 12.5 million in new enrollments
- Used Docker, Jenkins, and Openshift to help maintain local and QA development environments.
- Created and refactored Javascript unit tests via the Jasmine test framework
- Worked with and added to our in-house atomic design system to help maintain accessibility standards

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Used .NET and web-based languages to work on in-house projects.
- Worked in a team and solved problems based on client demands.
- Learned how to work and solve problems with concepts and languages that I had never used before.
- Learned how to adapt to large codebases and any new concepts presented in them.
- Great experience gained using .NET in conjunction with web languages to complete tasks and  present user interfaces.
